prompt_fragment:
This asset is an icon. Use crisp, reduced shapes, bold edges, and high readability at very small sizes.
Keep the icon silhouette bold, crisp, and readable at 16px.
raw_description:
An adult emperor penguin warlord, front view, tall and lean with a
long straight beak and upright dignified stance. A small three-point
crown on the head. Holding a short sword point-down at the side.
Saturated colored belly, dark body.
formatted_prompt:
STYLE: flat modern app icon; bold vector geometry with crisp hard edges; single centered subject on plain off-white canvas; generous padding all sides; Phosphor Fill / SF Symbols Filled register; every shape readable at 16px

SUBJECT: adult emperor penguin, front-facing, tall and lean with narrow pointed straight beak, small dark eyes proportional to skull, upright dignified posture, sleek plumage; small three-point crown centered on head; short sword held point-down at one side, gripped at the handle; dark body plumage, saturated colored belly panel

CONTEXT: isolated app icon, no scene, no background elements, centered on plain off-white canvas

COLOR: body and wings in #0000FF deep flat blue-black; belly panel in #FFFF00 saturated yellow; three-point crown in #FF6600 vivid orange; sword blade in #FFFFFF white; sword handle in #FF0000 red; beak in #FF6600 orange; feet in #FF6600; crown and sword read as distinct flat secondary shapes against the body

DETAILS: all edges sharp and deliberate vector geometry; interior details rendered as flat secondary-color shapes; belly panel, crown points, and sword hilt each a distinct flat fill; no gradients, no textures, no brushwork, no ink strokes; clean crisp silhouette bold enough to read as a closed shape at 16px; adult anatomical proportions throughout, lean and tall

CONSTRAINTS: flat icon only; zero painterly rendering; zero grain or weathering; no cartoon proportions; no oversized eyes; no juvenile anatomy
